what: Cross-seed morphology-distance NULL from D3 E3.1's three seeds. Establishes (a) that the null RISES monotonically with epoch, so an endpoint threshold measures elapsed training, and (b) the between-pair spread that calibrates E4's +-0.15 threshold.
calibration_status: PROVISIONAL. epochs_common ends at 372 because at least one seed is still running, so the last window rests on a truncated range for every pair that seed belongs to. Regenerate with e4_null_traj.py once all seeds reach 399. MUST NOT be cited for an E4 verdict while it says PROVISIONAL.

threshold_derived.formula: SE(delta) = pair_sd * sqrt(1/3 + 1/12), for 3 within-run and 12 between-run role-matched pairs
